ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to 6 months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days of expiry or termination, return to Customer all Content in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Content from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit provision to Section 3.5 so that, on expiry or termination, IBM provides up to 6 months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our Content in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and thereafter deletes and certifies deletion. The return deadline now runs from exit rather than a later request, so we are not left without our Content in a hosted environment.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Content return/deletion obligations into Section 3.5, with the 30-day return running from expiry or termination
